candidate.quote: no pongo duda que todo el año siembran panizo y cogen
candidate.summary: Columbus notes year-round sowing of 'panizo' on an island in the Bahamas.
candidate.limits: 'Panizo' is a millet-type word; this text does not say maize, so identifying it with maize is an inference. The text is in third person elsewhere ('Dize el Almirante'), i.e. an abstract, not Columbus's own hand.
